vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-45829
vulnerability.description: ChromaDB Python project has a pre-authentication code injection vulnerability.

statements.impact_statement: chromadb is used only as an embedded, file-backed store: mcp_server/tools/cve_search.py builds a chromadb.PersistentClient inside the MCP server process, and the deployment runs no ChromaDB service at all (docker-compose ships mcp-server, agent-api, seed-job, frontend and jaeger). The advisory's vector is pre-authentication, so it lives in the server's request-handling path, and that path is never started here: the vulnerable code ships inside the installed package but sits outside every execution path. Version 1 of this statement argued network unreachability of a ChromaDB endpoint, which described the deployment inaccurately - there is no endpoint to reach. No patched chromadb release exists (advisory range >= 1.0.0 <= 1.5.9; 1.5.9, released 2026-05-05, is still the latest on PyPI as of 2026-08-03), so this statement is revisited when a fixed version ships.
